title: Wick-burn Issues
text:
Wick-burn Issues. This brand sub’d for my usual Y-candle subscribe & save last month. The scent is wonderful & very close to my usual brand.

But I found major issues with the wicks: They burn faster than the wax, leaving small stubs that are hard to light. Pouring off some melted wax at each burn helps a bit, but this really defeats any longevity possibilities, and is messy and potentially dangerous.

If this had been a single wick candle, I would probably give it the benefit of the doubt, but both wicks had this issue, so I won’t be trying it again.
